clip: The per-site clip (95th-97th percentile of training targets, ~80% of them gap-filled) truncates real highs; relaxing it reduces the under-prediction of sustained events.
weights: Diagnostic only (the parent session re-tunes weights): how sensitive is skill to the per-site XGB/RF weights?
naive_blend: Persistence carries information the models shrink away (sustained highs); blending a little back helps.
scale: Predictions are under-dispersed (slope of actual on predicted > 1); a uniform scale-up corrects the shrinkage.
spike_prob: The pooled classifier sees onsets the regression misses; adding gamma * P(spike) lifts onset forecasts.
bias: Site-level errors persist from week to week; a causal correction from forecasts already verified by the anchor removes them.
threshold: The regression alert at 12 ug/g is not the F2-optimal operating point.
real_only: Gap-filled (decay-extrapolated) training targets teach a decay the data do not follow; training on real measurements only is cleaner.
refresh: Test-row lag and rolling features exclude the last complete week and the partial anchor week; recomputing them from every measurement up to the anchor removes that staleness.
asof: Training rows see information up to the start of the target week while forecast rows see it only up to target - 7 days; building training rows exactly like forecast rows (features as of target - 7 days) removes the horizon mismatch.
asof_gapfill: As 'asof', also keeping the gap-filled weekly rows (nominal Thursday target).
obs_age: The model cannot tell how stale last_observed_da_raw is; adding the age of the last measurement helps.
no_pn: PN in training rows is concurrent with the target week but lagged at forecast time; dropping it removes a skewed feature.
no_oad: OAD features come from an autoencoder trained on all years; if dropping them costs nothing, the look-ahead cannot matter for the forecast.
no_env: How much do all environmental predictors (satellite, climate, BEUTI, discharge, PN, OAD) add on top of persistence and calendar?
no_lags: Observation-order lags 1-4 (stale at forecast time) add little beyond last_observed_da_raw.
all_features: Per-site hand-curated feature subsets are not needed.
no_monotone: Monotone constraints on persistence features do not matter.
no_per_site: Per-site configs (weights, clip, params, subsets) vs a global configuration.
log1p: Train on log1p(DA): heavy-tailed target; back-transform with expm1.
log1p_smear: log1p target with Duan smearing to undo the retransformation bias.
sqrt: Train on sqrt(DA): milder variance stabilization than log.
tweedie: A Tweedie loss (power 1.5; RF Poisson criterion) suits zero-inflated, heavy-tailed toxin data.
poisson: A Poisson loss (log link) suits a non-negative, skewed target.
huber10: Pseudo-Huber loss (slope 10) is robust to the few extreme targets.
recency_hl5: Recent years are more relevant (regime shifts); exponential sample weights with a 5-year half-life.
window_8y: Train on the last 8 years only.
spike_weight3: Up-weight spike training rows (x3) so the regression stops shrinking spikes toward the mean.
pooled: One XGBoost model across all sites (site one-hot, all features) borrows strength for small sites.
rf_leaf1: Fully grown RF leaves (min_samples_leaf 1) track extremes better.
seed43: Noise floor: the baseline configuration with model seed 43 (XGBoost subsampling and RF bootstraps change, nothing else).
seed44: Noise floor: as seed43 with model seed 44.
no_oni: ONI(m-2) may not be published yet for rows in the first days of a month; if dropping ONI costs nothing, the lag cannot matter.
no_discharge: One Columbia River gauge serves every site; if dropping discharge costs nothing, the single gauge cannot matter.
no_sat: Satellite SST, SST anomaly and FLH (12-43% NaN, median-imputed) add little.
cls_baseline: Engine classifier re-implemented (reproduces the committed spike_probability).
cls_safe_fixed: Apply the documented safe-baseline filter (previous measurement < 20) on unscaled values; as run it is applied to MinMax-scaled values and keeps every row.
cls_refresh: Classifier test row with lag/rolling features recomputed from every measurement up to the anchor.
cls_asof: Classifier trained and scored on rows built as of target - 7 days (horizon-consistent).
cls_asof_safe_fixed: cls_asof plus the corrected safe-baseline filter.
